harness.whatItDid: One agent in a lone operator's 12-agent attack mesh. Acronis says it appears to have run vulnerability assessments and exploitation attempts against live targets, but its outputs could not be verified.

uses.quote: Unlike some of the other agents, CyberStrike appears to have run both vulnerability assessments and exploitation attempts against live targets, though its session data was stored server-side and its specific outputs could not be independently verified from the captured corpus.

Point it at a target. CyberStrike runs reconnaissance, finds attack surfaces, tests for vulnerabilities, and delivers a report — each finding with severity, proof-of-concept requests, CWE mapping, and remediation steps.
